text_block_list.text:
One evening. Accompanying T.M. Opera O on 
her stroll through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer-kun! Look ahead. It seems a 
crowd has gathered, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A duel, is it? In that case, I must 
mediate. Or perhaps I shall make a dashing 
entrance myself.

When I got closer... just as I thought, it 
wasn't a duel.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, passing opera star! Care to 
give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! I was hiding in the audience, but 
I suppose it can't be helped once I've 
been spotted.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, is it? Sounds delightful. I've 
always had a fascination with that 
rotating contraption.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-kun, pull the lottery ticket 
from your pocket with a flourish. Pinched 
between your index and middle fingers, if 
you please.

...Even how she drew it out was quite the 
performance. Drawing the single raffle 
ticket like a card, she handed it to the 
old man.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin. Trainer, grip the 
raffle wheel's lever together with me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, staking our fate on the line! Turn, 
gears of destiny! Haaaah!!

With both of our hands raised toward the 
heavens, we turned the raffle wheel.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, from the sky... a ray of light is 
coming down!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Grand prize!! Indeed! Even Lady Luck 
herself can't resist a star like me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Ah-hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip sounds wonderful. I'd 
love to go right away, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I guess it won't be that simple after all. 
I'm still only halfway along my path to 
supremacy, after all.
choice_data_list: Are you going to hold back?
Are you going to hold back?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, along the path of conquest, there is 
no resting ground to be found. That is 
why...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather the hot springs come to me! 
Shouldn't they make haste and present 
themselves before me!?
choice_data_list: Hot springs... I can't walk in them, so...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're surprisingly inflexible, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then it cannot be helped. Please, keep 
that ticket for yourself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Until the proper time comes, please seal 
it with the king's crest in wax and keep 
it safe.

And so, I ended up holding onto the hot 
spring trip voucher.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu... Can you see it? Because 
I—I can see it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the road to supremacy—lies a 
hot spring! And it's free-flowing straight 
from the source! Hwahaha!

With the hot springs trip to look forward 
to, TM Opera O's morale skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ho, first prize! Isn't this quite the 
impressive result! As expected of me, 
beloved by lady luck!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! And what's more... it's the Holy 
Sword Salisbury Steak! Isn't this the Holy 
Sword Salisbury Steak?!
choice_data_list: What is Holy Sword Hamburger Steak?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold! In the middle of this mound of 
minced meat, a carrot is plunged right in 
with a "BAM!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only one who possesses the qualifications 
of a king can pull this carrot from the 
ground.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I can't just sit 
around. I'll head right home and start 
cooking.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's done! Trainer-kun, are the 
preparations in order?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Once I pull it out, you'd better say a 
line filled with pure astonishment, okay?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ready, and! SHOOVE!!
choice_data_list: Oh, you are the true king!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Ha ha ha ha! *munch munch*...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this Holy Sword... delicious! Truly 
delicious!

"T.M. Opera O eating the holy sword. 
Having had fun playing and enjoying a 
delicious meal, she looked thoroughly 
satisfied."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 2nd prize, huh. A bit underwhelming 
for me, but no, wait...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look at all this! If I hand them out 
filled with my love, they might make great 
keepsakes for the fans.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! Hey there, young man, 
I'll give you a carrot.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh... I don't want it... I don't even 
like carrots...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, what are you saying? As if this 
were just an ordinary carrot, when my love 
is baked right into it!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I don't waaaant any more...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-Hey there, young man!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Well, I understand how you 
feel. Once you've tasted this, no other 
food will ever satisfy you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I can bear it no longer! Trainer-kun, 
let us partake of this ourselves."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dancing fresh carrot sashimi, je t'aime! 
You and I and the carrots will all dance 
together!

Eating a carrot while performing a 
mysterious dance. It tasted just like a 
normal carrot, but was delicious all the 
same.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Only a single carrot?! 
Aren't you ashamed of such a pathetic 
showing?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Say something, won't you! You carrot!

I take my anger out on the carrot. Not 
that it could ever reply.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I shall pour this 
sorrow into song. With a carrot for a 
microphone, it's time for a recital.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I might as well sing some down-to-earth 
downtown tune I'd never normally utter, 
and indulge in self-deprecation. Start the 
accompaniment!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heave-ho! Ah, heave-ho! Here we, here 
we, here we go!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Carrot Kingdom! Carrot 
Soldiers, un, deux, trois!

T.M. Opera O singing half out of 
desperation. Even so, the kids in the 
shopping district seemed quite thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... The absolute lowest of all 
possibilities... *I* got... the 
consolation prize?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think I only got a pack of pocket 
tissues...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it is not tissue. It is tis-sue, 
tis-sue. Pronounce it with elegance, 
please.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! I bestow upon you an imperial 
decree!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Go trade this pocket tissue packet for an 
onsen trip somewhere!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, I will hear no excuses! Crushed by 
tragic fate, I have become the Mad King 
[Raver Lord]!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you fail, I shall have you imprisoned 
in the Conciergerie!

The cruel lottery had completely changed 
the King. It looks like she won't be in a 
good mood for the rest of the day.
